name: Retry shows on a failure no read can fix
a press on the record shows while it is read
a final failure says nothing
replace: [] status = "failed" /\ ~retryable -> "Says why reading again cannot help"

name: a failure hides a kept record
a re-read blanks the record
replace:
/\ status' = "waiting"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<retryable, drawn, got, standing, keeps>>

/\ status' = "waiting"
  /\ drawn' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<retryable, got, standing, keeps>>
